name: @blackbelt-technology/pi-dashboard-craft-web-plugin
description: Dashboard plugin that edits and views files in the editor pane with the ArtCraft web builds (WordCraft, GridCraft, PdfCraft, CADCraft, DesignCraft, SoundCraft in place; PhotoCraft, VectorCraft, DeckCraft saving their native format next to the file; LightCraft view-only RAW) in a sandboxed opaque-origin frame as editor-pane-file-handler modes. Builds are provisioned on demand (checksum-verified GitHub release, inline scripts externalized, adapter profile + shim injected), served read-only through ctx.serveApp under an enforced CSP with no programmatic network access, and saved only through the core write-binary path behind per-format validators. Disabled by default (defaultEnabled: false) — opt in via settings.

claims.label: Edit in WordCraft
claims.firstOverwriteNotice: Saves are re-rendered by WordCraft's own writer; formatting of unsupported features may change. A copy is the safe way to compare.

claims.label: Edit in GridCraft
claims.firstOverwriteNotice: Saves are rewritten by GridCraft's own writer; formulas, charts or formatting it does not support may change. A copy is the safe way to compare.

claims.label: Edit in PdfCraft
claims.firstOverwriteNotice: PdfCraft does not report which file it opened. Check that it shows this file before overwriting. PdfCraft appends your changes as an incremental update and keeps the original bytes. A copy is the safe way to compare.

claims.label: Edit in CADCraft
claims.firstOverwriteNotice: CADCraft does not report which file it opened. Check that it shows this file before overwriting. Saves are rewritten by CADCraft as DXF R2000; entities it does not support may change. A copy is the safe way to compare.

claims.label: Edit in DesignCraft
claims.firstOverwriteNotice: DesignCraft does not report which file it opened. Check that it shows this file before overwriting. Saves are rewritten by DesignCraft with its assets embedded; content it does not support may change. A copy is the safe way to compare.

claims.label: Edit in SoundCraft
claims.firstOverwriteNotice: SoundCraft does not report which file it opened. Check that it shows this file before overwriting. Saves are rewritten by SoundCraft with the session's audio files; content it does not support may change. A copy is the safe way to compare.

claims.label: Edit in PhotoCraft
claims.firstOverwriteNotice: PhotoCraft saves layered .psd files; formats it does not support may change. A copy is the safe way to compare.
